title: Comfort Club Reinstated-Term Dues: Gross Dues, Discount and Amount Billed
content:
Billing schedule for the term dues of a reinstated annually billed agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. The term dues are worked out in this order.

1. **Gross dues.** The first-system rate plus the tier's additional-system annual rate multiplied by the additional-system share, for each enrolled system beyond the first.
2. **Dues discount.** The loyalty discount, the trouble-free discount and the protection bundle discount are added together into one percentage, which is taken once off the gross dues. The discounted dues are rounded to the cent half up.
3. **Term dues.** The term dues are the discounted dues for the whole term.

**Values used.** The first-system rate is the tier's current first-system annual rate. The additional-system share is one (1.0). The loyalty, trouble-free and protection bundle discounts are zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical Comfort Club Gold agreement, two enrolled systems)

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| First-system rate | the tier's current first-system annual rate | 249.00 |
| Additional systems | 169.00 multiplied by a share of one, for 1 system beyond the first | 169.00 |
| Gross dues | 249.00 plus 169.00 | 418.00 |
| Dues discount | 0% in total | 0.00 |
| Term dues | discounted dues for the whole term | 418.00 |

## The combined discount
The three discounts are never applied one after another. A hypothetical combined percentage of 8% plus 3% plus 2% is 13%, taken once off the gross dues: 418.00 less 13% is 363.66.
